reviewer: AI assistant initial labels; evaluation author confirmed the judgments

human_review.scope: All 64 candidate relevance judgments and known-development matches
human_review.method_detail: The evaluation author reviewed and accepted the initial judgments.

rubric: Relevant = in-window new Hong Kong McDonald's offer, limited food, or membership activity. Old/recurring offer roundups and unrelated topics are irrelevant. Matching a known development does not require the official URL.
limits: Candidate pool precision is not Precision@K: connector sorts by publication date.
Known-development coverage is not whole-web recall.
Most Google News redirect entries supplied only headlines.
The evaluation author reviewed and accepted the initial labels.
